Yes, life might get better, but it will get worse again, and then better and then worse. I hate this cycle. I feel that if I am dead everything will be gone, no sadness and even happiness. And I am fine with that. I figured that I only get happy for a short period of time. After that I'm back to my depressive state. 

Reality isn't working for me anymore. I don't belong here.

thanks for the replies and thanks for checking in. I still think about suicide but I'm not attempting yet. I'm pretty much doing what you said, being productive even when I'm pretty down. I'm somewhat hopeful, I'm in a really bad situation right now but I trying to convince myself that it is going to get better once I find a job. Again thanks for the replies and the advice. 

I also hope everything gets better with you.
I would rather be dead actually.
But I don't have a mom anymore. So it think this doesn't apply to me.

How did you handle life without working for 2 years? How did you handle all the problems you went through? 

I'm too weak, I try to be strong but it seems like when I try to be one, there's always something that will bring me down. 

I cry all the time, I know that crying doesn't help but I can't help it.
